summary: Completed comprehensive testing for Nevika Cura Phase 2 features. Backend: All 18 API tests PASSED for Health Insights, Health Score, Health Streaks, Medicine Lookup/Search, and Family Wallet. Frontend: Health Insights page displays score ring (72/Good), streak card, risk alerts, wellness tips, and quick actions. Medicine Scanner page has Search/Scan Barcode modes with working search (found Paracetamol 500mg). Patient Profile shows all 10 menu items correctly with navigation to health-insights and medicine-scanner. Track Order page shows empty state with health metrics when no orders exist. Reorder/Book Again buttons implemented but require orders to display.

issues: IntroScreen carousel appears frequently during testing, blocking interactions. Not a bug but may affect user experience if triggered too often.

critical_code_review_comments: FamilyMemberPicker only appears when family members exist - this is correct behavior as documented
Reorder/Book Again buttons in TrackOrder.js only render for existing orders - correct implementation

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All pages load and function correctly

seed_data_creation: Added 2 family members for FamilyMemberPicker testing, logged health streak activities
